limitations: Installed Windows WebView2 and RTX4070 behaviour remain unverified here; neural inference and Windows packaging were not exercised.
Shape Lab supports simple closed polygon contours, without separate hole contours, and full360-degree revolutions only.
Shape Lab maintains procedural recipes. Cutting and sculpt brushes are available through Save & edit in Builder; mesh edits do not reverse-engineer profile controls.
Strong twists and deeply concave outlines may self-intersect; this is not a general solid-intersection solver.
Session autosave retains completed recipe data, not the tracing image, undo history or pending gestures. Saved shape drafts retain the tracing image.
Other GLB viewers may show hidden objects retained in full-scene exports because visibility uses editor metadata.
AI texturing, rigging, automatic compartment layout and external production writes remain future work.
